summary: Staggered batch onboarding: SCIM mismatch & KMS tagging policy question
description: Issue summary: A staggered bulk onboarding job for 48 new hires completed in partial waves this morning. Several accounts provisioned via SCIM lacked expected department and cost_center attributes which caused automated KMS key tagging to skip for ~18 VMs and 12 loaner laptops. Impact: delayed provisioning of encrypted assets and manual intervention for KMS tag reconciliation; HR reports 14 engineers unable to access pre-provisioned devices. Environment: prod-us-west SCIM connector -> Okta -> internal provisioning lambdas. Expected: SCIM mapping should include department/cost_center on first sync and downstream scripts should apply KMS tags automatically. Actual: intermittent attribute drop observed when new hires were created in overlapping waves; downstream tag job skipped objects missing the tag keys.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger staggered create of 40+ Okta users in waves (10 users every 3 minutes) with identical attribute payload
2) Observe SCIM connector logs and provisioning lambda logs for each user create event
3) Inspect created resources in inventory service for presence of department and cost_center tags
4) Run KMS tagging job and note skipped resources where tags were missing

investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: SCIM connector batching during overlapping waves caused attribute normalizer to drop optional fields under load
Checked okta provisioning logs: majority of missing attributes align with users created in wave 2 and wave 4 when job concurrency peaked
Reviewed recent infra change: onboard-scripts PR #412 introduced a small refactor to SCIM transform that changed attribute validation order (see related_github_prs)
Confirmed KMS tag job correctly refuses to tag resources missing department/cost_center (by design) — prevents mis-tagging but results in manual work
No evidence of data corruption in Okta itself; attributes are present in some user records and absent in others immediately after SCIM event

2026-03-06 14:22 SRE Oncall (Leila Park): Applied temporary workaround: re-run normalize+provision flow for affected users and queued KMS tag job; all tags applied and devices encrypted. Logging alerts added for missing attrs.

resolution: Workaround applied on 2026-03-06: re-ran normalization and provision flow for affected users, queued KMS tag job which applied tags to the 18 pending resources. Root-cause: recent refactor changed attribute validation order and exposed a race under staggered multi-wave creates. Temporary rollback of PR #412 to trunk; added guard in SCIM transform to enforce attribute presence before emitting provisioning events.
